gpu.description: A node's accelerator. kind 'none' (with zero throughput) is a CPU-only node; the named kinds are GPU families. Throughput is a single comparable scalar (teraFLOPS), not a vendor benchmark.

kind.description: The accelerator family. Append-only enum (the lowercase name is the stored identifier).

throughput_tflops.description: Coarse throughput in teraFLOPS the autoscaler ranks placements by. 0 when there is no GPU.

provisioned_node.description: A node a Provisioner has stood up (or, for the Local backend, an existing cluster node it reports): identity + reachable address + capability. Mirrored by zetta::ProvisionedNode in include/zetta/provisioner.hpp (ProvisionedNode::from_json in src/core/provisioner.cpp).

address.description: host:port to reach the node. Optional; omitted/empty when the node is not networked.

node_id.description: The node's stable id (its cluster / CRDT actor id).

description: The node capability model (ENT-32, part of the native distributed accelerated compute pass for UC-1 churn — ARC-13). Describes one node's compute resources — CPU cores, memory, and an optional GPU (type + throughput) — used both as the capability a node reports and as the per-node floor a provision request asks for. Mirrored by zetta::NodeCapability in include/zetta/node_capability.hpp and enforced by NodeCapability::from_json() in src/core/node_capability.cpp — keep them in sync. Distinct from the access-control capability in access_key.schema.json (that is a *right*; this is *compute*). A malformed capability is rejected at the boundary so a node never silently over- or under-states what it offers.

cores.description: Logical CPU cores the node provides.

gpu.description: The node's accelerator. Optional; absent means CPU-only (equivalent to kind 'none').
